DOWNFALL-VOTING.rules_text:
- You must sign in with Steam to upload. Your submission is tied to your Steam account.
- [b]No NSFW, gore, or otherwise offensive content[/b] - this will get your Steam account banned from uploading.
- [b]No AI-generated art.[/b]
- Submissions are reviewed before they appear for voting.
- [b]Images must be an exact fixed size:[/b]
   - Normal cards: 500x380 or 1000x760 px
   - Ancient cards: 606x852 px
- You can withdraw your own pending submission any time from "My Submissions".
